We're gearing up for the 2027 iteration of the Philly Native Plant Project, and we need YOUR HELP!
This year we distributed 15,000 packets of native plant seeds throughout the city. We're doing it again!
We've got seeds, we've got stickers, we need YOUR hands to help us pack everything up.
We'll provide beers and pretzels, you bring those paws. We'll have some fun educational material to share out with your neighborhoods too.
